package main

import (
	"math"
	"runtime"

	"example.com/controllercheck/.karty/engine"
	fpscontroller "example.com/controllercheck/.karty/processed/code/controllers-3d.sdk/controller"
)

var memory runtime.MemStats
var negativeControl []byte
var plain, physics bool
var camera *engine.Camera3D
var player *fpscontroller.FirstPersonController
var updates, proposals uint64

//go:wasmexport karty_use_first_person
func useFirstPerson(mode uint32) { physics, plain = mode&1 != 0, mode&2 != 0 }

//go:wasmexport karty_register
func main() {
	if plain {
		engine.Run(playerClient{})
		return
	}
	engine.Run(engine.Hooks{OnStart: start, OnUpdate: observe})
}

type playerClient struct{}

func (playerClient) Initialize() { start() }
func (playerClient) Update(frame engine.Frame) { observe(frame) }
func (playerClient) Shutdown() {}

func start() {
	game := engine.Game{}
	camera = game.NewCamera3D(9, engine.Camera3DSettings{
		Projection: engine.CameraProjectionPerspective, Output: engine.CameraOutputFull,
		Position: engine.Vec3{Z: 1.7}, VerticalFOV: 1, OrthoHeight: 8,
		NearClip: .1, FarClip: 100, ViewportWidth: 1280, ViewportHeight: 720,
	})
	options := fpscontroller.DefaultFirstPersonOptions()
	if !physics { options.Mode = fpscontroller.FirstPersonFree }
	options.BeforeMove = func(_ *fpscontroller.FirstPersonController, _ *fpscontroller.FirstPersonMotion) { proposals++ }
	var err error
	player, err = fpscontroller.AttachFirstPerson(game, camera, options)
	if err != nil { panic(err) }
}

func observe(engine.Frame) {
	updates++
	if updates != proposals { panic("controller must run once before every game update") }
}

//go:wasmexport karty_allocations
func allocations() uint64 { runtime.ReadMemStats(&memory); return memory.Mallocs }

//go:wasmexport karty_allocated_bytes
func allocatedBytes() uint64 { runtime.ReadMemStats(&memory); return memory.TotalAlloc }

//go:wasmexport karty_negative_control
func allocate() { negativeControl = make([]byte, 2048); negativeControl[0] = 1 }

//go:wasmexport karty_first_person_state
func state(index uint32) uint64 {
	switch index {
	case 0: return updates
	case 1: return proposals
	case 2: return uint64(camera.ID())
	case 3: if player.TouchMode() { return 1 }
	case 4: return uint64(math.Float32bits(camera.Settings().Position.X))
	case 5: return uint64(math.Float32bits(camera.Settings().Position.Y))
	case 6: return uint64(math.Float32bits(camera.Settings().Yaw))
	case 7: return uint64(math.Float32bits(camera.Settings().Pitch))
	}
	return 0
}
